description: For Sirte teachers, LANA reports 35+ schools, but that is a site count, not participant turnout. Separate Mar 9 protest stands and the Mar 19 ninth-day multi-school sit-in may overlap or be an escalation; the start/episode boundary remains pending. Neither article documents >=50 simultaneous people at any one site or a genuinely organized combined event. The ministry confirms demands and a committee pledge but not crowd attendance.
The Mar 31 Zawiyya protest is reported with state-directed security/service demands, but attendance is absent. One-month ultimatum is a future condition, not evidence of later protest or compliance.

Search is open web in English/Arabic, not LexisNexis or systematic local press archive access. Historical source ledgers are absent; exact checks/manual review were performed for opened URLs, with no global clean-history claim. Other regions/sectors and unindexed Arabic coverage may be missed.
Official baseline/version, licensing and independent scientific review remain pending. Research proposals are not approved Mass Mobilization rows.
Teacher sit-in ending or April continuation is not established. No direct link to February events is demonstrated; January is covered separately in this package.
